integrity: Analytic perturbation with explicit coefficients; supplied reproducibility script and recorded execution; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only a local small-aperture asymptotic at each fixed crossing index; no uniform-in-index bound and no full finite-aperture crossing census. Full Morrison (1963) primary text inaccessible; residual possible priority overlap. Numerical tests support but cannot certify the infinite theorem.
title: Universal finite-aperture drift of bandpass-prolate parity crossings
